title: NA21003: Marine Construction And Welding
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneIntroduction to various types of ships and offshore
structures; Aspects of shipbuilding technology; Structural components - bottom
construction, shell plating, decks, fore and aft peak construction,
superstructure and deckhouses, bulkheads; Framing system; Structural
continuity; Steel material preparation - shot blasting, acid pickling etc;
Plate cutting methods; Plate and section forming - mechanical methods and line
heating techniques; Fusion welding â types of power source and their
characteristics, welding methods - MMAW, GMAW, SAW, Electroslag welding;
Welding parameters and their effect on welded joints; Welding distortionscauses and prevention; Welding defects; Nondestructive testing.
